provenance.series_policy: fixed rolling 42-month window through previous complete calendar month
provenance.ring_policy: NDVI/HSI rings use GEE observed rolling 16-day composite ending UTC yesterday (T-1); daily --ring-only; island_reef_hsi_v1 (no mudflat); fallback monthly end if window invalid
provenance.note: S21 partial（仅矾坨子）直至四分量官方点齐；S22 工作 AOI 待保护区官方界替换。均为站址 AOI 重跑，非邻站克隆。
